evidence_quote: Since 20% of his gross income equals his car payment of $400, we can set up the equation:
question_evidence_quote: Ben spends 20% of his after-tax income on his car.
observed_error: The response applies the 20% car-payment rate to gross income instead of after-tax income.
violated_condition: The $400 payment equals 20% of after-tax income, which is two-thirds of gross income.
error_description: The response sets the $400 car payment equal to 20% of gross income, although the question specifies 20% of after-tax income. Dividing 400 by 0.20 is arithmetically correct, but the resulting $2000 is after-tax income, not gross income; the subsequent tax subtraction propagates this incorrect assignment.
